content.comment_body: We're attempting to write to an SD card using the [product_name] web editor, but the system always indicates 'SD NOT FOUND'. The card is a 32GB microSD, prepared with a single 2GB FAT32 partition and a 4096KB allocation size.

You can format the whole microSD card using FAT32, there's no need for a single partition. How did you format the card? I usually format microSD cards on a Windows 7 PC using a full format (not quick format) and haven't encountered problems with various card sizes. Does the [product_name] diagnostic provide any information? Check [product_name] main menu > diagnostic > hardware > SD card for details.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is having trouble with a [product_name] web editor not recognizing a microSD card, consistently getting an 'SD NOT FOUND' error message. Partitioning a 32GB microSD down to a 2GB FAT32 partition hasn't solved the issue. Another forum participant suggests full FAT32 formatting and checking diagnostics in the hardware menu, noting that the device typically works with different microSD card sizes if formatted correctly.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates straightforward compatibility with commonly available FAT32-formatted microSD cards and expects [product_name] web editor and device to reliably detect and interact with the card.
